70	    onEvent(AncEvent.LabDraftChanged(LabDraftField.UNIT, item.unit))

import androidx.compose.ui.platform.testTag
import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.sherifradwan.ancnative.R

@Composable
fun SectionCard(
    title: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    tag: String? = null,
    content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit,
) {
    val cardModifier = Modifier
        .fillMaxWidth()
        .then(modifier)
        .let { if (tag != null) it.testTag(tag) else it }

    Card(
        modifier = cardModifier,
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant.copy(alpha = 0.5f)),
        elevation = CardDefaults.cardElevation(defaultElevation = 1.dp),
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
        ) {
            if (title.isNotBlank()) {
                Text(
                    text = title,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                )
            }
            content()
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun SummaryRow(
    label: String,
    value: String,
    tag: String,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
    val notSetText = stringResource(R.string.finding_not_set)
    val displayText = value.ifBlank { notSetText }
    val isNotSet = displayText == notSetText

    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .heightIn(min = 48.dp)
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
            .testTag(tag)
            .padding(vertical = 4.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
        Text(
            text = label,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false),
        )
        Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
        ) {
            Text(
                text = displayText,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                fontWeight = if (isNotSet) FontWeight.Normal else FontWeight.SemiBold,
                color = if (isNotSet) {
                    MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                } else {
                    MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
                },
            )
            Icon(
                imageVector = Icons.Default.KeyboardArrowDown,
                contentDescription = null,
                tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp),
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun BigChoiceButton(
    label: String,
    selected: Boolean,
    tag: String,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    enabled: Boolean = true,
) {
    val containerColor = if (selected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface
    val contentColor = if (selected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
    val borderColor = if (selected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant

    OutlinedButton(
        onClick = onClick,
        enabled = enabled,
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .heightIn(min = 56.dp)
            .testTag(tag),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
        border = BorderStroke(if (selected) 1.5.dp else 1.dp, borderColor),
        colors = ButtonDefaults.outlinedButtonColors(
            containerColor = containerColor,
            contentColor = contentColor,
        ),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
            Text(
                text = label,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
                fontWeight = if (selected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Medium,
                color = contentColor,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false),
            )
            if (selected) {
                Icon(
                    imageVector = Icons.Default.Check,
                    contentDescription = null,
                    tint = contentColor,
                    modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp),
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

**Review of Round 5b (laboratory entry screen)**

I could not run `git diff` because I only had read tools. I read the final `LabEditor.kt`, `DesignSystem.kt`, `strings.xml` and the spec. I cannot confirm S213 (nothing changed under model/, state/ or storage/), what the old chips did, or whether any string was deleted. I ran no tests.

**Hard Blockers**
- None found.

**Should-fix**
1. **Open-on-entry rules are not re-applied after "Add another test".**
   - The open flags are only set once, in `rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(initialEditDetails) }` (lines 144–149). Line 595 and line 633 then set `editDetailsOpen = step.item.unit.isBlank() && ...`.
   - After a loaded test is saved with "Add another", the new draft is blank. `editDetailsOpen` can still be false, so `labName` is hidden under the title "New test".
   - `addTestsOpen`, `flagSectionOpen` and `noteSectionOpen` also keep the previous test's state.
   - This only matters if the same composable instance survives across drafts, which the panel-queue design assumes. Re-derive the flags when `draft.labId` changes, inside the existing `LaunchedEffect(draft.labId)` at line 175.
2. **Possible vertical text at 160% font in the flag/note chip row (lines 471–493).**
   - The Row has no `weight` and no `maxLines`. "Flag · abnormal" plus "Note ✓" can overflow or wrap inside a chip. A `FlowRow` or `maxLines = 1` would fix it.
3. **Same risk in the banner at lines 648–657.**
   - The text `"New test: add it to your lab test list?"` has no `weight(1f)`, so the "Add to list" button can be squeezed into a vertical stack. Add `Modifier.weight(1f)` to the text.
4. **Strings are hard-coded in `LabEditor.kt`, against L309 ("each once").**
   - The affected text is `"Test $currentPanelIndex of $panelTotalCount · …"` (333), the preset labels `"Negative"`, `"Non-reactive"`, `"Normal"` and `"Positive"` (459), and `"Note ✓"` (488).
   - Some of the other hard-coded strings may predate this round. I could not diff to tell. Examples are `"1. Laboratory Details & Date"`, `"📦 Diagnostic Panels:"` and `"Add to list"`.

**Nits**
- `testNameFocusRequester` (lines 124 and 403) is attached but never requested. If it was already there before this round, ignore it; otherwise it is dead code.
- `SummaryRow` always shows a down arrow, so the "Open/Close" value is the only sign of state (`DesignSystem.kt:112`).
- The flag section Row at line 501 is `clickable` without a `role`, so it is announced as a plain clickable. The Switch inside handles its own taps, so there is no double toggle.
- `val initialAddTests = ... && panelTotalCount <= 1` (148) is always true at first composition, because `panelTotalCount` starts at 0. This is harmless but misleading.
- `LabResultFlagPill` still uses the literals `"Normal"`, `"High"` and `"Low"`.

**Checked and OK**
- **Fields and events:**
  - Every tag named in the spec is present: `labNameField`, `labDate`, `labName`, `labUnit`, `labRefRange`, `labResult`, `labAbnormal`, `labNotes`, `labCategoryChoice*`, `allLabTestsChip`, `labGroupChip-*`, `labPreset*`, `labNamePreset*`, `saveToLabCodexBanner`, `saveToLabCodexButton`, `cancelLab`, `addAnotherLab`, `saveLab`, `pinnedLabHeaderTag` and `labCalculatedGaCard`.
  - Each event is still sent: `LabDraftChanged` for each field, `LabAbnormalChanged`, `SubmitLab`, `SubmitLabAndAddAnother` and `CancelEditor`.
- **Rotation:** the panel queue (ids, total, index, current item, `currentLabId`, `selectedGroupName`) is still `rememberSaveable`, using `StringListSaver`.
- **Progress line:** it follows the L303 rule, and the title falls back to `R.string.new_test`.
- **Presets:** each preset sends `LabDraftChanged(RESULT, preset)`, and the `labResultPreset-<index>` order is Negative, Non-reactive, Normal, Positive. T303 clicks index 3, which is Positive.
- **Cards and reuse:** there is no `Card(` in `LabEditor.kt`. `SectionCard` and `SummaryRow` are reused, and `BigChoiceButton` is defined once at `DesignSystem.kt:123`.
- **Colours and touch targets:** only theme colours are used. `BigChoiceButton` has `heightIn(min = 56.dp)`. The toggles, chips and bottom bar use `minimumTouchTarget`, and `SummaryRow` and the flag row have 48 dp minimums.
- **Old strings:** nothing references the removed "Edit unit and range" button.
- **Existing tests:** `AncWorkflowTest` (lines 607–610) uses `labName` and `labResult` on a blank new lab. Details are open there, so it should still work.
